official_sources.title: Environment Agency time-stamped LiDAR point-cloud lineage
official_sources.finding: Time-stamped point clouds contain classified 3D returns and underpin DTM/DSM rasters, but historical archiving means a matching point cloud may not exist for every surface model; manual DTM editing also means classified ground points need not equal the final DTM.
official_sources.limitation: Point-cloud samples are diagnostic lineage evidence and cannot silently replace the published, manually edited DTM.

official_sources.title: Environment Agency independent LiDAR ground-truth archive
official_sources.finding: Independent flat-surface ground-truth points have ±3 cm RMSE accuracy and record date, surface, survey method, transformation and geoid; EA timestamped surveys must be below ±15 cm RMSE and 10 cm standard-deviation/random-error limits to pass quality control.
official_sources.limitation: Programme QC does not prove the uncertainty of a specific parcel extremum without the selected survey's exact ground-truth result and raster support.

official_sources.title: National LiDAR Programme tile identity and classifications
official_sources.finding: Five-kilometre tiles are named with survey ID, OS grid reference and first/last flown dates; LAZ returns are classified into ground and vegetation classes, while DTM and DSM products retain distinct terrain/surface semantics.
official_sources.limitation: Classification and file naming establish provenance, not target elevation accuracy or parcel-boundary identity.

official_sources.title: GDAL affine geotransform and pixel-centre rule
official_sources.finding: GDAL maps pixel/line coordinates to georeferenced coordinates with a six-parameter affine transform; the centre of the upper-left pixel is at pixel/line (0.5, 0.5).
official_sources.limitation: Correct cell positioning does not establish the raster's vertical datum, survey accuracy or parcel support.

official_sources.title: OGC GeoTIFF raster-type semantics
official_sources.finding: GeoTIFF 1.1 requires raster-space interpretation through GTRasterTypeGeoKey, distinguishing PixelIsArea from PixelIsPoint.
official_sources.limitation: The tag must be reconciled with geotransform and product documentation; it is not a vertical-accuracy statement.

official_sources.title: GDAL NoData filling is synthetic interpolation
official_sources.finding: GDAL fill-nodata creates values by interpolation from valid pixels around NoData edges and can use a validity mask where zero means invalid.
official_sources.limitation: Filled cells are not observed LiDAR elevations and are rejected for parcel minima/maxima unless separately labelled as diagnostics.

official_sources.title: GDAL average resampling excludes NoData but smooths extrema
official_sources.finding: Average resampling computes weighted averages of contributing non-NoData pixels.
official_sources.limitation: Averaging changes local minima and maxima and cannot be used as an unqualified parcel height-difference source.

official_sources.title: GDAL uncovered-raster zero default guard
official_sources.finding: Pixels inside an output extent but outside all source rasters may be read as valid zero unless an output NoData value is explicitly specified.
official_sources.limitation: Zero must never be accepted as elevation merely because coverage or NoData metadata was omitted.
